headline: Case Manager, RSW

experience.title: Case Manager
experience.employer: Kudarat Women and Children Protection Center
bullets: Manage about 25 active cases of women and children survivors of violence and abuse.
Provide social counselling and safety planning, and accompany clients to court and medical appointments.
Write case studies, progress notes and court reports that meet agency and legal standards.
Refer clients to shelters, legal aid, livelihood and psychosocial programs and coordinate with each provider.

experience.title: Social Worker
bullets: Worked with children in conflict with the law and their families.
Advocated for diversion programs instead of detention in case conferences.

summary: Registered social worker with four years of case management for women, children and youth in Sultan Kudarat. I provide counselling, protect clients at risk, advocate for them in case conferences and courts, and look at every part of a client's life when planning services. My case records are thorough and court-ready.
skills: Protection of vulnerable women and children

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Social Work
